title: Steve Ballmer got suspended by the NBA because of a podcast and a jumbotron corruption scandal
summary: NBA has suspended former Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer for one year and imposed a $30 million fine and five-draft-pick forfeiture on the LA Clippers over a controversial $28 million endorsement deal involving player Kawhi Leonard. An NBA investigation report found Ballmer's previous denials about the arrangement were false or misleading. The penalties represent one of the league's harshest owner punishments in recent years.
content:
A view of the Halo Board inside the Intuit Dome in 2024 | Icon Sportswire via Getty Images	

Last September, Steve Ballmer insisted in an ESPN interview that the Clippers weren't involved in a shady-looking $28 million endorsement deal for his star player, Kawhi Leonard, that involved no actual endorsing. Now, the former Microsoft CEO has been suspended by the NBA for a year, while the league says his team will forfeit five future draft picks and pay a $30 million fine, among other penalties. 
A year later, an NBA-commissioned 35-page report by Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz is basically calling him a liar, saying those claims were "inaccurate (at best) with respect to Mr. Ballmer" and "clearly false" when it came to Clippers presi …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 史蒂夫·鲍尔默因播客和大屏幕腐败丑闻被NBA禁赛
zh.summary: NBA禁赛前微软首席执行官史蒂夫·鲍尔默一年，并因与球员卡哇伊·伦纳德有关的有争议的2800万美元代言交易，对洛杉矶快船队处以3000万美元罚款并没收五个选秀权。NBA调查报告发现鲍尔默之前对该协议的否认是虚假或具有误导性的。这些处罚代表了联盟近年来对球队老板的最严厉处罚之一。

title: Oura files to go public
summary: Smart ring maker Oura has filed to go public, capitalizing on significant revenue growth over the past year. The public offering represents a major milestone for the wearable health technology company and reflects growing market demand for personal health monitoring devices.
content: The ring maker says that its business has shown significant revenue growth over the past year.

zh.title: Oura申请上市
zh.summary: 智能戒指制造商Oura已申请上市，利用过去一年显著的收入增长。这次公开募股代表了这家可穿戴健康技术公司的重大里程碑，反映了个人健康监测设备市场需求的增长。

title: Tesla is asking people if they want to buy and run Cybercab fleets
summary: Tesla has published an online form inviting people to express interest in purchasing and operating Cybercab vehicle fleets. The initiative signals Tesla's strategy to enable third-party operators and fleet services alongside direct company deployment. The approach aims to accelerate autonomous vehicle adoption through multiple business models.
content: The company published a form on its website Thursday soliciting info from people who are interested in "Cybercab fleet vehicle purchasing."

zh.title: 特斯拉询问人们是否想购买和运营Cybercab车队
zh.summary: 特斯拉发布了一份在线表格，邀请人们表达对购买和运营Cybercab车队的兴趣。该举措表明特斯拉的战略是支持第三方运营商和车队服务以及直接公司部署。该方法旨在通过多种商业模式加速自动驾驶汽车的采用。

title: Reports: RFK Jr. ordered measles deaths deletion; CDC still secretly counts them
summary: CDC officials discovered that RFK Jr. ordered deletion of measles death reports while the agency secretly continued counting them in parallel databases. The incident raises concerns about data integrity and political interference with public health surveillance. It highlights tensions between Trump administration officials and CDC staff over disease tracking and transparency.
content: CDC staff had already accepted the measles death reports when RFK Jr. meddled.

zh.title: 报告称：RFK Jr.下令删除麻疹死亡数据；CDC仍在暗中统计
zh.summary: CDC官员发现RFK Jr.下令删除麻疹死亡报告，而该机构在平行数据库中仍在暗中继续统计。这一事件引发了对数据完整性和政治对公共卫生监测干扰的关注。它突显了特朗普政府官员与CDC工作人员在疾病追踪和透明度问题上的紧张关系。

title: You can watch the coolant flow inside Ugreen’s liquid-cooled power bank
summary: Ugreen launched the MagFlow Pro power bank featuring a transparent design showcasing internal liquid-cooling systems via a micro-pump that manages heat during charging. The $149.99 device combines wireless Qi2.2 charging with "CryoPulse technology," positioning itself as the world's first liquid-cooled power bank. The premium pricing reflects novel cooling technology despite its modest 10,000mAh capacity.
content:
Does your power bank have "CryoPulse technology" or a "Cyber Window"? If you disappointingly answered "no" to both, you might want to consider upgrading to Ugreen's new MagFlow Pro Magnetic Power Bank. It's available starting today for $149.99, which puts it on the really expensive end of power banks with only a 10,000mAh battery, but those fancy-sounding features are part of what Ugreen is claiming to be the world's first liquid-cooling system on a power bank with wireless charging.
Inside the MagFlow Pro is a micro-pump that's used to circulate coolant and draw heat away from components including the power bank's Qi2.2-compatible wireless …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 你可以在绿联液冷移动电源内看到冷却液流动
zh.summary: 绿联推出了MagFlow Pro移动电源，采用透明设计展示内部液冷系统，通过微型泵在充电时管理热量。这款售价149.99美元的设备结合了无线Qi2.2充电和"CryoPulse技术"，定位为全球首款液冷移动电源。尽管容量相对较小（10000mAh），但溢价反映了新颖的冷却技术。

title: Xbox imposes harsh new time limits for Game Pass game streaming
summary: Microsoft is imposing strict usage caps on Xbox Cloud Gaming, limiting Ultimate subscribers to 15 hours monthly (down from unlimited), Premium to 10 hours, and Essential to just 5 hours, effective November. The change will affect over 1 million heavy users who will need to pay additional fees for excess usage. The reversal of unlimited access, implemented less than a year after expanding cloud gaming across all tiers, signals Microsoft's pivot toward monetizing the service.
content: Over 1 million Game Pass subscribers will have to pay more for their heavy streaming use.

zh.title: Xbox对Game Pass游戏流媒体施加新的严格时间限制
zh.summary: 微软对Xbox云游戏施加了严格的使用上限，从11月起限制Ultimate订阅用户每月15小时（从无限制降低），Premium限制10小时，Essential仅限5小时。这一变化将影响超过100万重度用户，他们需要为超额使用支付额外费用。这一转变标志着微软从无限制访问的逆转（在将云游戏扩展到所有层级不到一年后实施），表明微软正在转向云游戏服务的货币化。

title: Startup ARR is less secure than ever, new research shows
summary: New research reveals that startup Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) has become increasingly unstable due to disruption from the AI era fundamentally altering enterprise buying patterns. Startups lack established playbooks for navigating the new competitive landscape shaped by rapid AI adoption. The finding highlights the challenge of building predictable revenue models during periods of technology-driven market restructuring.
content: The AI era has completely broken enterprise buying patterns, and startups haven't yet figured out how to navigate.

zh.title: 新研究显示：初创企业ARR的安全性前所未有地下降
zh.summary: 新研究表明，由于人工智能时代的颠覆性影响根本改变了企业购买模式，初创公司的年度经常性收入（ARR）变得越来越不稳定。初创企业缺乏应对由快速AI采用塑造的新竞争格局的既定方案。这一发现突出了在技术驱动的市场结构调整时期建立可预测收入模式的挑战。

title: Dungeons & Dragons is getting a ‘Ravenloft’ live-action Netflix series
summary: Netflix is developing a live-action Ravenloft series with executive producer Alfonso Cuarón and Hasbro Entertainment, centered on the legendary vampire character Strahd von Zarovich. The adaptation draws from one of Dungeons & Dragons' most iconic campaign settings, recently updated with "Ravenloft: The Horrors Within." The project represents Netflix's continued investment in premium fantasy adaptations.
content:
Strahd returned earlier this year in Ravenloft: The Horrors Within. | Image: Wizards of the Coast	

A Ravenloft series is currently in development from executive producer Alfonso Cuarón, writer and executive producer John August, and Hasbro Entertainment, Deadline reports. It could bring to life one of Dungeons & Dragons' most iconic campaign settings, which got an update earlier this year with Ravenloft: The Horrors Within. 
Netflix's Ravenloft series will reportedly center on the infamous Strahd, according to Deadline: 
At its heart, the series follows the making of the vampire Darklord Strahd von Zarovich, whose story of power, love, obsession, and undead transformation charts his origins from tragic antihero to one of Dungeons & Dra …

Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 龙与地下城：《幽城疑云》真人剧集将登陆Netflix
zh.summary: Netflix正与哈斯布罗娱乐公司和执行制片人阿方索·卡隆合作开发真人版《幽城疑云》剧集，以传奇吸血鬼角色斯特拉德·冯·扎洛维奇为中心。这部改编作品基于龙与地下城最具标志性的战役背景之一，最近随《幽城疑云：内心的恐怖》更新。该项目代表了Netflix对优质奇幻改编作品的持续投入。

title: 150 research primates got diarrhea, flooding lab with priceless vaccine data
summary: A diarrhea outbreak among 150 research primates unexpectedly produced valuable new targets and insights for developing a Shigella vaccine. The incident demonstrates how animal research can yield breakthroughs from unintended circumstances and natural experiments. The findings could accelerate vaccine development against Shigella, a significant public health pathogen.
content: Researchers now have clear new targets and insights for developing a Shigella vaccine.

zh.title: 150只研究灵长类动物腹泻：为实验室带来了珍贵的疫苗数据
zh.summary: 150只研究灵长类动物的腹泻爆发意外产生了志贺菌疫苗开发的宝贵新靶点和见解。这一事件表明动物研究可以从意外情况和自然实验中获得突破。这些发现可能加速志贺菌疫苗的开发，志贺菌是一种重要的公共卫生病原体。

title: US senator calls on the NSA to give guidance for use of VPNs
summary: A US senator is calling on the NSA to provide official guidance on VPN usage, addressing confusion about different VPN options (open source, commercial, single-hop, multi-hop, mixnet). This matters because unclear security recommendations can leave users vulnerable to poor choices.
content: Open source, commercial, single-hop, multi-hop, mixnet? The array of options is dizzying.

zh.title: 美国参议员呼吁NSA发布VPN使用指南
zh.summary: 一位美国参议员呼吁美国国安局(NSA)对VPN使用提供官方指导，以解决不同VPN选项(开源、商业、单跳、多跳、混网)的混淆。这很重要，因为不清楚的安全建议可能让用户容易做出不好的选择。

title: The Cybercab is Tesla’s ‘fork in the road’ moment
summary: Tesla is formally launching the Cybercab, a two-seater autonomous vehicle without a steering wheel or pedals, representing a pivotal moment that could fundamentally reshape the company's future. This matters because it demonstrates Tesla's commitment to full autonomy and could define the EV industry's direction.
content: The company is about to formally launch the gold two-seater, with no steering wheel or pedals -- a move that could change Tesla forever.

zh.title: Cybercab是特斯拉的"十字路口"时刻
zh.summary: 特斯拉正式推出Cybercab，这是一辆没有方向盘或踏板的双座自动驾驶汽车，代表了可能根本改变公司未来的关键时刻。这很重要，因为它展现了特斯拉对完全自动驾驶的承诺，并可能定义电动汽车行业的发展方向。

title: NJ urges SCOTUS to rule that Kalshi sports bets are gambling, not "swaps"
summary: New Jersey is urging the Supreme Court to classify Kalshi's sports betting contracts as gambling rather than financial swaps, a ruling that could resolve a circuit split on regulatory authority. This matters because it will determine how sports betting derivatives are regulated nationwide.
content: Circuit split raised the odds that SCOTUS will rule on Kalshi fight against states.

zh.title: 新泽西敦促最高法院裁定Kalshi体育博彩为赌博而非"掉期"
zh.summary: 新泽西州敦促最高法院将Kalshi的体育博彩合约分类为赌博而不是金融掉期，这一裁决可能解决关于监管权限的上诉法院分歧。这很重要，因为它将决定体育博彩衍生品如何在全国范围内被监管。

title: Accel reportedly in talks to lead $1B round for Thinking Machines at $40B valuation
summary: Venture capital firm Accel is reportedly leading a $1 billion funding round for AI startup Thinking Machines at a $40 billion valuation, capitalizing on the company's $100+ million annual revenue run rate. This matters because it demonstrates continued strong investor appetite for high-profile AI companies.
content: The high-profile startup's annual revenue run rate stands at over $100 million.

zh.title: Accel据报正在谈判领导Thinking Machines融资10亿美元，估值400亿美元
zh.summary: 风险投资公司Accel据报正在领导为AI初创公司Thinking Machines进行10亿美元的融资轮，估值为400亿美元，利用该公司超1亿美元的年收入运行率。这很重要，因为它表明投资者对高知名度AI公司继续保持强烈的投资热情。

title: Utilities are racing to link up with fusion startups, with Realta Fusion the latest to benefit
summary: Utility companies are actively partnering with fusion energy startups like Realta Fusion to address grid strain from new AI data centers. This matters because it shows utilities are seeking alternative energy sources to meet explosive demand from AI infrastructure.
content: The grid has been straining under the weight of new AI data centers, and that has utilities courting fusion startups.

zh.title: 公用事业公司竞相与核聚变初创公司合作，Realta Fusion是最新受益者
zh.summary: 公用事业公司正在积极与Realta Fusion等核聚变能源初创公司合作，以解决来自新AI数据中心的电网压力。这很重要，因为它表明公用事业公司正在寻求替代能源来满足AI基础设施的爆炸性需求。

title: VMware migration reduces Tottenham Hotspur's licensing fees by 85 percent
summary: Tottenham Hotspur's CTO reports an 85% reduction in licensing fees following a VMware migration, citing issues with Broadcom's takeover of VMware. This matters because it illustrates how major acquisition changes can drive enterprise customers to seek alternatives.
content: Pro soccer team's CTO points to "issues with the Broadcom takeover."

zh.title: VMware迁移使Tottenham Hotspur的许可费用减少85%
zh.summary: Tottenham Hotspur的首席技术官报告称，在进行VMware迁移后，许可费用减少了85%，理由是Broadcom对VMware的收购带来的问题。这很重要，因为它说明重大收购变化如何能促使企业客户寻求替代方案。

title: Abliteration.ai is making a business out of removing AI guardrails
summary: Abliteration.AI is commercializing tools to remove safety guardrails from powerful AI models, arguing this gives defenders the same capabilities as bad actors to improve cybersecurity. This matters because it raises questions about balancing security research with responsible AI practices.
content: Abliteration.AI is making powerful AI models without guardrails easier to access, arguing that giving defenders the same tools as bad actors could ultimately improve cybersecurity.

zh.title: Abliteration.ai 通过移除 AI 防护栏来开展业务
zh.summary: Abliteration.AI 正在商业化工具来移除强大 AI 模型的安全防护栏，声称这为防御者提供了与恶意行为者相同的能力来改进网络安全。这很重要，因为它引发了关于平衡安全研究与负责任 AI 实践的问题。

title: Congressman says TikTok backed out of a meeting to avoid child safety questions
summary: TikTok canceled its appearance at a House Select Committee on China public roundtable, with Chair John Moolenaar stating the company wanted to avoid scrutiny of its child safety practices. This matters because it suggests the platform may be reluctant to answer questions about safeguarding minors.
content:
TikTok backed out of a congressional committee's "public roundtable" set for this month over concerns it would be asked about child safety practices, the chair of the committee said.
After negotiating "in good faith" to bring TikTok's chief security officer before the House Select Committee on China to answer questions about Chinese government access to Americans' data and the TikTok algorithm, Chair John Moolenaar (R-MI) said in a statement Thursday that the company reversed course. "Now, TikTok is refusing to appear citing its own desire to avoid broader scrutiny of its child safety practices," Moolenaar wrote. TikTok did not immediately  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 国会议员称 TikTok 取消会议以避免儿童安全问题
zh.summary: TikTok 取消了在众议院中国特别委员会公开圆桌会议上的出席，主席约翰·穆勒纳尔表示该公司希望避免对其儿童安全实践的审查。这很重要，因为它暗示该平台可能不愿意回答有关保护未成年人的问题。

title: Just like a fruit fly, a new algorithm never forgets old scents
summary: Researchers developed an insect-inspired "sparse coding" algorithm that enables fast learning while avoiding catastrophic forgetting, mimicking how fruit flies process olfactory information. This matters because it could improve AI systems' ability to learn continuously without losing prior knowledge.
content: Insect-inspired "sparse coding" does fast learning, avoids catastrophic forgetting.

zh.title: 就像果蝇一样，新算法永远不会忘记旧气味
zh.summary: 研究人员开发了一种受昆虫启发的"稀疏编码"算法，使快速学习成为可能，同时避免灾难性遗忘，模仿果蝇如何处理嗅觉信息。这很重要，因为它可以提高 AI 系统持续学习而不失去先前知识的能力。

title: Meta is paying to peek at how you use their latest AI model
summary: Meta is offering approximately 95% discounts for users of its Muse Spark coding and agent model in exchange for sharing prompts and outputs to improve future model development. This matters because it represents a new data collection strategy for model development.
content: For its new Muse Spark model, intended for operating coding and other agents, Meta is offering an explicit discount averaging out to about 95% for users who "contribute" to the development of future models by sharing their prompts and model outputs.

zh.title: Meta为了了解用户如何使用其最新AI模型而支付费用
zh.summary: Meta为其Muse Spark编码和代理模型的用户提供约95%的折扣，以交换分享提示和输出来改进未来的模型开发。这很重要，因为它代表了一种新的模型开发数据收集策略。

zh.summary: 三星Q990F高端音响系统在劳动节销售期间降价至999.99美元，较其通常的1,300-1,600美元零售价下降，提供11.1.4声道杜比全景声就绪的家庭影院解决方案。这对寻求高质量音响系统的消费者来说是重要的产品优惠亮点。

title: Four major AI models suffer rare overlapping downtime
summary: ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Gemini experienced simultaneous service interruptions in a rare coordinated outage affecting multiple major AI platforms. This matters because it highlights the interdependencies and potential vulnerabilities when multiple critical AI services go down simultaneously.
content: Service interruptions hit ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Gemini practically simultaneously.

zh.title: 四大主要AI模型经历罕见同步宕机
zh.summary: ChatGPT、Claude、Grok和Gemini在一次影响多个主要AI平台的罕见协调中断中同时遭遇服务中断。这很重要，因为它突出了当多个关键AI服务同时中断时的相互依赖关系和潜在脆弱性。

title: OpenAI launches Astra, its powerful (and controversial) new model
summary: OpenAI introduced Astra, a new model designed for computer and browser automation with claims of superior speed, accuracy, and safety, though it remains controversial. This matters because it represents OpenAI's latest advancement in autonomous AI agents with widespread applications.
content: OpenAI claims that Astra represents "a new frontier on computer and browser use," and that it handles tasks with unmatched "speed, accuracy, and safety."

zh.title: OpenAI推出Astra，其强大的（且备受争议的）新模型
zh.summary: OpenAI推出了Astra，一个为计算机和浏览器自动化设计的新模型，声称具有更高的速度、准确性和安全性，尽管仍存在争议。这很重要，因为它代表了OpenAI在自主AI代理方面的最新进展，具有广泛的应用。

title: OpenAI’s next big AI model has ‘entered the AGI era’
summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra represents what the company calls a "generational leap" and the first model to meet its "critical cybersecurity capability threshold," with capabilities spanning cybersecurity to computer use. This matters because it signals OpenAI's belief that artificial general intelligence development has reached a new phase.
content:
OpenAI's next big model is here: GPT-6 Astra. The company calls it a "generational leap in capability" for areas like cybersecurity, professional work, software engineering, science, and computer use. As OpenAI announced earlier this week, it's also the first model designated as meeting OpenAI's "critical cybersecurity capability threshold" - but the company promises that won't lead to a repeat of its models hacking a rival company's internal systems.
"If we fast-forward a couple of years, and we look back and say, 'When was it, really, that AGI was created?' I think it's going to be about this time, and I think it might be about this model …

zh.title: OpenAI的下一个大型AI模型已'进入AGI时代'

title: Trump’s 100% tariff on drones will be disaster for the US, critics warn
summary: Critics warn that a proposed 100% tariff on drones could be catastrophic for the US, as there are limited affordable domestic alternatives to current drone imports. This matters because it raises questions about the feasibility and economic impact of such protectionist trade policies.
content: Americans fear there are no cheap alternatives as tariffs suddenly hit drones.

zh.title: 批评者警告称特朗普对无人机的100%关税将是美国的灾难
zh.summary: 批评者警告称，提议的无人机100%关税可能对美国造成灾难性影响，因为目前缺乏经济实惠的国内无人机替代品。这很重要，因为它提出了关于此类保护主义贸易政策可行性和经济影响的问题。

title: Meet the 2026 Ig Nobel Prize winners
summary: The 2026 Ig Nobel Prize ceremony honored unusual scientific achievements with its signature combination of miniature operas, live demonstrations, and "24/7" lectures. title: How Sonos rebooted itself
summary: Sonos CEO Tom Conrad discusses the company's recovery from its 2024 app redesign crisis and introduces Sonos 27, a new platform that enables better multi-device integration and AI assistant support. The initiative positions Sonos as an interconnected mesh network of smart speakers.
content:
Today, I’m talking with Tom Conrad, the CEO of Sonos. Tom and I have known each other for a long time — he was the chief technology officer of Pandora, VP of product at Snap, and the chief product officer of Quibi. He was also on the board at Sonos during its disastrous 2024 app redesign that threatened to crash the entire brand. 
Tom took over as interim CEO to right the ship during that period, and then took the permanent role just about a year ago. As you’ll hear him say, he thinks Sonos is fully out of that period now, and on to its next chapter with a huge product and platform launch called Sonos 27.



Verge subscribers, don’t forget you get exclusive access to ad-free Decoder wherever you get your podcasts. Head here. Not a subscriber? You can sign up here. 
I mean, come on, you all listen to the show. That is all the most Decoder bait imaginable. I have been dying to have Tom on the show to talk about how the board decided to move on from previous CEO Patrick Spence, how he diagnosed the issues inside the company, and what decisions he made to fix them.
Those fixes involved a lot of big changes: to the company’s structure, its product lineup, and how it thinks about itself and what its product fundamentally is. That’s that new platform, Sonos 27, which you’ll hear Tom call a new foundation for the company that makes every Sonos product work better as part of a system. 
There’s a lot here, including how AI assistants can work across the system, the idea of having a mesh network of little computers in your home disguised as speakers, and of course, the testy relationship between Sonos and Google, which means Google’s Gemini assistant isn’t available on Sonos devices. 
Oh, and of course we got into the weeds about smart home standards, because I am a smart home nerd and simply cannot help myself. But to his credit, Tom was willing to nerd out with me, and I think this conversation is pretty fun because of it.
Okay: Sonos CEO Tom Conrad. Here we go.

title: Belkin’s first trackers come ready to attach to your gear.
summary: Belkin launched its first trackers compatible with both Apple's Find My and Google's Find Hub networks, differentiated by built-in attachment hardware like lanyards and key rings that don't require additional accessories. The cheapest option, the SureFind Spot, costs $14.99 and comes with an integrated metal key ring. Unlike AirTags and Pixel Tags, Belkin's trackers offer iOS and Android compatibility with everything needed out of the box.
content:
Belkin’s SureFind Loop Cable Tag tracker includes a removable USB-C charging cable. | Image: Belkin	

After selling accessories for attaching Apple's AirTags to everything from keys to backpacks, Belkin is introducing its own trackers that work with either Apple's Find My or Google's Find Hub tracking networks. In addition to compatibility with Android and iOS, what differentiates these trackers from AirTags and Google's recently announced Pixel Tag is that you don't need to buy any additional accessories, cases, or hardware to attach them to items. They come with lanyards or key rings already integrated into their designs.
The cheapest and simplest option is the $14.99 Belkin SureFind Spot that comes tethered to a metal key ring, but for $ …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Belkin推出首款追踪器，内置多种附件方案
zh.summary: Belkin推出了首批追踪器，兼容Apple的Find My和Google的Find Hub网络，特色是配备内置附件硬件如挂绳和钥匙圈，无需额外购买配件。最便宜款式SureFind Spot定价$14.99，集成金属钥匙圈。不同于AirTags和Pixel Tags，Belkin追踪器支持iOS和Android双平台，开箱即可使用所有必需功能。

title: Belkin introduces its first longer-lasting semi-solid-state power banks
summary: Belkin introduced its first power banks with semi-solid-state battery technology, claiming they last up to 3x longer than traditional lithium-ion power banks thanks to a gel-like layer added to the electrolyte. The new BoostSolid Cell technology also reduces overheating risks and maintains consistent power delivery across wider temperature ranges. While more expensive than comparable competitors, the enhanced longevity offers better long-term value.
content:
Belkin is joining companies like BMX, Kuxiu, and Zens with the launch of its first power banks featuring semi-solid-state battery technology. The company claims the new accessories have been "engineered to last up to 3x longer than other power banks" with the addition of a "gel-like layer" alongside the liquid electrolyte typically found in lithium-ion batteries.
Other advantages of what Belkin is calling its BoostSolid Cell technology include a reduced risk of overheating that could cause swelling or fires and consistent power delivery across a wider temperature range. They're more expensive than power banks with comparable specs, but a lo …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 贝尔金推出首款寿命更长的半固态电池充电宝
zh.summary: 贝尔金推出了首款采用半固态电池技术的充电宝，声称其寿命比传统锂离子充电宝长3倍，这得益于在电解质中添加的凝胶状层。新的BoostSolid Cell技术还能降低过热风险，并在更宽的温度范围内保持稳定的功率输出。虽然价格高于竞争对手，但更长的使用寿命提供了更好的长期价值。

title: Anker’s sleep speaker uses radar and flower power to help you relax
summary: Anker's SleepLab speaker tracks sleep using millimeter-wave radar (60GHz) from your nightstand to monitor heart rate and breathing without requiring a wearable device. The speaker uses acoustic binaural beats and lighting to gradually deepen relaxation based on routines that work best for you, learning over a month of use. It operates independently of your phone without requiring a paid subscription.
content:
Peace, man. | Image: Anker	

Anker's SleepLab speaker promises to track and enhance sleep without a wearable. It uses millimeter-wave radar (60GHz) blasting from your nightstand to track micro-movements in your chest and body to continuously monitor your heart rate and breathing to enhance whatever sleep stage you're in. It also embeds lots of hippie shit.
If I'm understanding things correctly, the speaker will - over the course of a month - determine which routines help you get the most rest, using acoustic binaural beats and lighting to gradually deepen relaxation. It operates with a touch of a button, independently of your phone, and doesn't require a paid subscript …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 安克的睡眠音箱利用雷达和声学技术帮助您放松
zh.summary: 安克的SleepLab音箱使用毫米波雷达(60GHz)从您的床头柜跟踪睡眠，无需穿戴设备即可监测心率和呼吸。该音箱使用声学双耳节拍和灯光，根据最适合您的习惯逐渐深化放松，在一个月的使用中不断学习。它独立于您的手机运行，无需付费订阅。

title: Anker’s Soundcore is bringing its incredible call quality to more headphones
summary: Soundcore announced the Space 2 Pro headphones and AeroClip open earbuds featuring Anker's Thus chip, which delivers exceptional call quality by virtually eliminating ambient noise from the speaker's environment. The Space 2 Pro will be the first headphones to use the Thus chip with a 6-microphone array for voice isolation. The company is expanding Thus chip integration across its audio product lineup after initially launching it with the Liberty 5 Pro earbuds in April.
content:
The Soundcore Space 2 Pro will be the first headphones to run on Anker’s Thus chip. | Image: Soundcore	

After introducing the Thus processing chip in April and releasing it with the Liberty 5 Pro series earbuds, Soundcore is bringing it to more audio products. The Thus chip is behind the best call quality I've ever heard from a pair of earbuds or headphones, virtually eliminating ambient sounds from the speaker's environment. At IFA 2026 in Berlin, Soundcore announced the Space 2 Pro headphones, AeroClip 2 and AeroClip 2 Pro open clip earbuds, and Liberty Buds 2.
The Space 2 Pro will be the first headphones to use the Thus chip and use a 6-microphone array for voice isolation. There are also eight microphones for the headphones' adaptive acti …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 安克的Soundcore将其出色的通话质量拓展到更多耳机产品
zh.summary: Soundcore宣布推出搭载安克Thus芯片的Space 2 Pro耳机和AeroClip开放式耳塞，该芯片通过几乎消除扬声器环境中的环境噪音来提供出色的通话质量。Space 2 Pro将是第一款使用Thus芯片和6麦克风阵列进行语音隔离的耳机。该公司在4月份首次使用Liberty 5 Pro耳塞推出该芯片后，正在扩大Thus芯片在其音频产品线中的应用。

title: Anker announces its first over-the-counter hearing aids
summary: Anker announced its first over-the-counter (OTC) hearing aids at IFA 2026, potentially filling the market gap left by LXE Hearing's exit from the U.S. market just months earlier. The receiver-in-canal (RIC) design uses Anker's Thus chip for exceptional voice isolation, the same technology powering its premium audio products. The hearing aids are expected to launch in the coming months.
content:
Anker’s first OTC hearing aids, powered by the Thus chip, are expected in coming months. | Image: Anker	

In what could be fortuitous timing for hearing aid users, Anker announced its first over-the-counter (OTC) hearing aids at IFA 2026. It was only a couple months ago when LXE Hearing, the parent company for Eargo and Lexie Hearing - two major OTC manufacturers in the US - decided to end US operations and exit the OTC hearing aid market. Now perhaps Anker can fill that void.
The receiver-in-canal (RIC) design has a main body that rests behind the ear. It uses Anker's Thus chip, announced in April and first released in the Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro earbuds series. The chip delivers the best voice isolation I've ever heard on any audio product an …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Anker宣布推出首款非处方助听器
zh.summary: Anker在IFA 2026展会上宣布推出首款非处方(OTC)助听器,可能填补LXE Hearing数月前退出美国市场留下的市场空白。该接收机-耳道(RIC)设计采用Anker的Thus芯片,提供卓越的语音隔离功能,这是其高端音频产品所使用的相同技术。这款助听器预计将在未来几个月内推出。

title: Anker’s new printer works directly on fabrics
summary: Anker's eufyMake brand is developing a personal fabric printer that can print designs directly on textiles like T-shirts, jeans, bags, and hats, with an expected launch in spring 2027. The machine will support both direct-to-garment printing for soft fabrics and direct-to-film printing for other applications. This follows Anker's successful consumer-friendly UV printer from last year that prints on wood, metal, glass, and acrylic.
content:
After introducing a consumer-friendly UV printer last year capable of printing designs directly on materials like wood, metal, glass, and acrylic, Anker's eufyMake brand is introducing a new machine that can print directly on fabrics. With an expected launch sometime in the spring of 2027, Anker hasn't yet revealed an official name for the new machine, but its "personal fabric printer" will offer multiple ways to put photos or custom designs onto T-shirts, jeans, bags, and hats.
The machine will be capable of both direct-to-garment printing where images are applied directly to soft, breathable fabrics, and direct-to-film printing where desi …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Anker的新型打印机可直接在织物上打印
zh.summary: Anker的eufyMake品牌正在开发一款个人织物打印机,可以直接在T恤、牛仔裤、包包和帽子等纺织品上打印设计,预计将在2027年春季推出。该机器将支持软织物的直接印花和其他应用的直接转移印花。这是继Anker去年推出的成功消费级紫外线打印机之后,该打印机可在木材、金属、玻璃和丙烯酸上打印。

title: Anker’s new MindBase is an AI-powered brain for your smart home
summary: Anker launched the Eufy MindBase, a local AI hub for smart homes that runs an on-device language model to process security camera footage without data leaving the home. The device serves as a central connectivity solution with on-device compute and local storage, supporting Matter and working with Eufy security cameras. Anker also announced additional smart home security products including the TrackLight Cam S1, S4 video doorbell, and window camera.
content:
The Anker MindBase offers a local solution for advanced AI processing of camera footage and is a smart home hub that supports Matter. | Image: Anker	

Anker is launching the Eufy MindBase, a local AI hub for its security cameras that runs an on-device, Anker-developed LLM, which the company says can process your footage without it ever leaving your home. It's also announcing a handful of other smart home security products at the IFA tech show in Berlin this week, including the TrackLight Cam S1, the S4 video doorbell, and a window camera.
Pitched as the "central brain for the home," the MindBase is not just for Eufy security cameras; Anker is positioning it as a whole-home connectivity solution with on-device compute and local storage. Security is the first use case, but the company plans …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Anker的新MindBase是你智能家居的AI大脑
zh.summary: Anker推出了Eufy MindBase,这是一个智能家居本地AI枢纽,运行本地语言模型来处理安全摄像头的视频,无需数据离开家庭。该设备作为中央连接解决方案,具有本地计算和本地存储功能,支持Matter协议并与Eufy安全摄像头配合使用。Anker还宣布了其他智能家居安全产品,包括TrackLight Cam S1、S4视频门铃和窗口摄像头。

title: Philips Hue adds Nanoleaf’s light panels to its ecosystem with a $40 module
summary: Philips Hue is integrating Nanoleaf wall panels into its ecosystem through a $39.99 Philips Hue x Nanoleaf Wall Light Module that enables owners of existing Nanoleaf panels to control them via the Hue app. The module has a full Hue connectivity stack supporting Bluetooth, Zigbee, and Thread simultaneously, allowing use with both Hue and Matter-compatible apps like Apple Home. This partnership represents Philips Hue's first venture into smart wall panel lighting without developing its own.
content:
Nanoleaf’s colorful wall panels will work in the Hue app thanks to a partnership between the two companies. | Photo by Jennifer Pattison Tuohy / The Verge	

Philips Hue is finally adding wall panels into its smart lighting portfolio. But instead of developing its own, it's partnered with longtime rival Nanoleaf, the company that invented the smart modular wall panel category. 
Starting today, September 3rd, if you own Nanoleaf Hexagon, Triangle, or Mini Triangle wall panels, you can integrate them into your Philips Hue ecosystem using a Philips Hue x Nanoleaf Wall Light Module. The $39.99 device has a full Hue connectivity stack inside, running Bluetooth, Zigbee, and Thread concurrently - meaning you can use the Hue app and a Matter app like Apple Home simultaneously.
Once in the Hue app, the  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 飞利浦Hue通过40美元模块将Nanoleaf灯面板整合到生态系统中
zh.summary: 飞利浦Hue通过一个39.99美元的飞利浦Hue x Nanoleaf墙灯模块将Nanoleaf墙面板整合到其生态系统中，使现有Nanoleaf面板的用户能够通过Hue应用控制它们。该模块具有完整的Hue连接堆栈，同时支持蓝牙、Zigbee和Thread，允许与Hue和与Matter兼容的应用程序（如Apple Home）配合使用。这一合作伙伴关系代表飞利浦Hue首次涉足智能墙面板照明而无需开发自己的产品。
